header: # levin-phase-floor 07d Part A: D-E, the candidate estimates scored

pairN4.basis: the pair plus a noise term; D-N (out/tables/d_n.md): the scatter is theta_mod_2pi's, independent node to node (lag-1 autocorrelation -0.016 group, 0.03 analytic), so CC_{2N-1} carries a noise error of standard deviation s_CC = sigma sqrt(sum w^2). sigma from the leaf's own 47 samples (standardChop's plateau) against the least-squares sigma: group median 0.98, p05 0.69, p01 0.54 (618 chopped of 994); analytic median 1.70, p05 0.88 (314 of 448). kappa = 4 makes kappa sigma_own / sigma >= 2.8 on 95% of chopped group leaves (P(|Z| > 2.8) = 0.5%); kappa = 3 is run beside it as the sensitivity. Where standardChop does not chop, sigma_own is read from the last 8 coefficients (truncation included, an upper reading).

nest3N4.basis: a third nested rule |CC_{4N-3} - CC_{2N-1}| (2N - 2 more evaluations) plus the noise term (as pairN4)

tail4N4.basis: 07c's coefficient tail, (b - a)/2 sum of the last four |c_k| of the fine interpolant, plus the noise term

chopN4.basis: the coefficient tail read with its plateau (Chebfun's standardChop, state/standardChop_rule.md, tol 2^-52): the decaying part as truncation, (b - a)/2 sum of |c_k| over the four coefficients up to the cutoff (tail_sum4 where it does not chop), the plateau as noise (the noise term)

pairtailN4.basis: max(pair, tail_sum4) plus the noise term: the larger of the two zero-cost truncation readings

pairDecl.applies: analytic blocks (the only calls declaring theta_abserr)
pairDecl.basis: the pair plus a noise term the caller declares: max(theta_abserr at the leaf's ends) x rms|f| x sqrt(sum w^2). D-N: declared theta_abserr x rms|f| over the measured sigma_g has median 4.1 on analytic leaves; group calls declare nothing (it would need a provider change, prompt section 0.6)
